programme.desc: Jenaye comes face-to-face for the first time with the woman her husband, James, slept with on their fifth wedding anniversary. The woman, Chelsey, who is also James's former hairstylist, tells her side of the story. Will Jenaye believe Chelsey's claims?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Brittany who says dad Charlie is being scammed by his online fiancée "Stephanie" & her roommate "Carina." Charlie hopes to get married when they meet in person. The real women in the photos are on stage & Charlie goes face-to-face!

programme.title: The Story Of Peter And The Potter
programme.desc: When Peter accidentally breaks a glass bowl intended as a birthday gift for his mother, Mr. and Mrs. Deichmann and their daughter Anneke, all artisans in clay, come to the rescue and make him one of their designs while Peter watches.

programme.title: Waiting For Fidel
programme.desc: Three Canadians, including ex-premier Joseph Smallwood and NFB director Michael Rubbo, travel to Cuba, aiming to cast Fidel Castro. Their journey offers insights into Cuba's changes and their own views.

programme.title: Nails
programme.desc: A blacksmith is seen labouring at his forge, shaping nails from single strands of steel rods. It then shifts from this setting to the roar of a twentieth-century nail mill, where machines, cut, and pound the steel rods faster than the eye can follow.

programme.title: Ill Find A Way
programme.desc: When nine-year-old Nadia is allowed to attend a regular school, she knows the kids will tease her but she'll "find a way to deal with it." Nadia has spina bifida, a congenital condition that has caused a lack of sensation from the knees down.

programme.title: Lost Over Burma Search For Closure
programme.desc: During the final days of the Second World War, an RCAF crew of six young Canadians sets out on a routine mission, dropping food and supplies for isolated Burmese villages. Their Dakota cargo plane takes off over the jungle--and vanishes without a trace.

programme.title: Gurdeep Singh Bains
programme.desc: Gurdeep is a thirteen-year-old Canadian Sikh whose family runs a dairy farm near Chilliwack, British Columbia. They have retained their language and religion. Sometimes he feels a little different from the other children because he wears a turban.

programme.title: Undertaker For Life!
programme.desc: Undertakers are anything but gloomy; they’re funny, generous and dedicated. We would gladly go on vacation with them, but sadly, they never have any dead time.

programme.title: Ninja Warrior UK
programme.desc: Competing alongside contestants are Radio 1's Rickie Williams and Melvin Odoom and `Love Island's' Laura Crane, but only those who complete the course and scale the four-metre Warped Wall will progress to the next stage of the competition.

programme.title: Ninja Warrior UK
programme.desc: Competing are `Dancing on Ice' professional skater Sylvain Longchambon, singer Joe McElderry and Olympian snowboarder Aimee Fuller, but only those who complete the course and scale the four-metre Warped Wall will progress to the semi-finals.

programme.title: Ninja Warrior UK
programme.desc: It's the semi-final, and with brand new obstacles to face, the course is more extreme than ever as the best competitors from four heats return to fight it out for a place in the final and get the chance to climb to the top of Mount Midoriyama.

programme.title: Ninja Warrior UK
programme.desc: It is the second part of the semi-final and, with brand new obstacles to face, the course is more extreme than ever, as the best competitors from four heats return to fight it out for a place in the final.

programme.title: Ninja Warrior UK
programme.desc: It's `The Eliminator'. Only the toughest competitors who complete the course against the clock will survive and go through to the Grand Final and get the chance to attempt the 22-metre rope climb to the top of Mount Midoriyama.
